observed_issues.detail: Probe sent SIGUSR2 after Python/uvicorn completion; child returned -12 without stack dump. Removed signal and application handler, replaced with read-only /proc observation. Failure evidence retained.

About 13.2 s between Uvicorn completion and process exit. During wait: state D, wchan folio_wait_bit_common, VmSwap 0. No attribution to a particular library or root cause established. Four managed cgroups empty afterward.
